run_GymEnv: run a GymEnv wrapper for the mjrl_point_mass-v0 MuJoCo environment
create_MLP_policy: create a Gaussian MLP policy with hidden layers of size 32x32 for the environment
build_MLPBaseline: build an MLPBaseline with regularization, batch size 64, and 10 training epochs
